changeSet.sql:
update metrics.AssetVersion set State = 3 where Uid in ( select uid from metrics.assetversion where state = 3 ) and State = 1
drop table if exists #soloMetrics
select uid, max(effectivedate) as EffectiveDate into #soloMetrics from metrics.assetversion where [state] = 3 group by uid
MERGE metrics.AssetVersion AV USING ( select uid, #soloMetrics.EffectiveDate, isnull(LastUsage.EffectiveDate, getdate()) as EffectiveEndDate from #soloMetrics outer apply ( select top 1 EffectiveDate FROM[metrics].[ScoreItem] where metricassetuid = #soloMetrics.Uid order by EffectiveDate desc )LastUsage )Data ON AV.State = 3 and av.uid = data.uid and av.effectivedate = data.effectivedate WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE set AV.EffectiveEndDate = data.EffectiveEndDate;
drop table if exists #multiMetrics
select uid, count(*) as count into #multiMetrics from metrics.assetversion where [state] = 3 group by uid having count(*) > 1
MERGE metrics.AssetVersion AV USING ( select av.uid, av.EffectiveDate, Next.EffectiveDate as EffectiveEndDate from metrics.AssetVersion av outer apply (select top 1 EffectiveDate from metrics.assetversion where uid = av.uid and av.effectivedate < effectivedate order by EffectiveDate )Next where uid in (select uid from #multiMetrics) )Data ON AV.State = 3 and av.uid = data.uid and av.effectivedate = data.effectivedate and data.effectiveenddate is not null WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE set AV.EffectiveEndDate = data.EffectiveEndDate;

changeSet.sql:
BEGIN DECLARE @fixedValue NVARCHAR(MAX) DECLARE LinkCursor CURSOR FOR SELECT f.Value FROM field f INNER JOIN fieldtype ft ON ft.id = f.fieldtypeid WHERE ft.type = 'Link' AND (f.Value LIKE '% |%' OR f.Value LIKE '%| %') FOR UPDATE OF Value, FormattedValue
OPEN LinkCursor
FETCH NEXT FROM LinkCursor INTO @fixedValue WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN WHILE (CHARINDEX(' |', @fixedValue) > 0) BEGIN SET @fixedValue = replace(@fixedValue, ' |', '|'); END WHILE (CHARINDEX('| ', @fixedValue) > 0) BEGIN SET @fixedValue = replace(@fixedValue, '| ', '|'); END
UPDATE Field SET Value = @fixedValue, FormattedValue = [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLinkValue](@fixedValue) WHERE CURRENT OF LinkCursor; FETCH NEXT FROM LinkCursor INTO @fixedValue END
CLOSE LinkCursor DEALLOCATE LinkCursor END
